title: Ground state preparation in two-dimensional pure Z2 lattice gauge theory via deterministic quantum imaginary time evolution
abstract_summary: Applies deterministic quantum imaginary time evolution (QITE) to prepare ground states of 2D pure Z2 lattice gauge theory. Constructs gauge-invariant Pauli operators respecting Gauss's law, reducing computational cost. Classical tensor network simulation achieves <0.1% relative error for 12-plaquette systems.
relevance_reason: Z2 gauge-invariant ground state prep with tensor networks — directly adjacent to our ALM+projection method. The <0.1% error benchmark is directly comparable to our 3.33% floor issue.
connection_to_project: Provides a quantum circuit approach (QITE) for Z2 gauge-invariant ground states that could resolve our 3.33% energy floor. The Gauss's law constraint enforcement is the same physics as our Z2 projection.
